features: AirWave Technology: For your ears only. Enjoy precise air conduction that keeps your playlist limited to you, even in an open-ear design
Open Beam Design Gen 2: Stay connected to your surroundings while staying plugged into your playlist. No need to take them off
Comfort that looks good: Designed with a soft, clip-on grip that fits snugly and stays on all day, every day
Up to 40 hours of playtime: Keep up with what’s happening when you’ve 6.5 hours of playtime on a single charge, and a total of 40 hours with the case
12 mm driver: Expect detailed and crisp audio with high-performance drivers, even with an open-ear fit
Dual device pairing: Connect to two devices and effortlessly switch between calls, playlists, and screens when needed
Low latency: Whether you’re gaming, streaming, or multitasking, stay locked in with audio that’s always lag-free and perfectly in sync
